evidence.PLN-01: hermes-tools-design.md Acceptance gives fourteen externally observable admission, execution, isolation, cleanup, browser and compatibility outcomes.
evidence.PLN-02: Acceptance maps AC-761 through AC-774 one-to-one to T-AC-761 through T-AC-774.
evidence.PLN-03: Execution architecture and ownership orders parent freeze/review, core shared types, dependent runtime integration, then stable UI and final frozen validation.
evidence.PLN-04: Scope explicitly makes actual cgroup/runsc qualification a prerequisite; unavailable proof must fail closed before model admission. Remaining resource/descendant/stop proofs are named rather than deferred beyond acceptance.
evidence.PLN-05: Qualification and evidence reuses the existing bus and isolates native/model/browser proof; no unsupported numerical delivery estimate is asserted. Prior cgroup-unqualified runsc evidence is explicitly insufficient.
evidence.PLN-06: Five exact first-party tools, pinned Hermes callback interception, Foundation journal, WSL user-service cgroup and existing owner artifacts make this project-specific.
evidence.PLN-07: Scope excludes shell/build under unchanged I10 KVM requirement, and defines useful fixed trusted file/data operations with exact task grants; no dedicated-host or general E07 completion is claimed.
evidence.PLN-08: Core owns contracts/store/core/API then UI; runtime owns native/Python/adapter; tests own tests only. Shared-type dependency is explicitly sequenced types-first, not claimed as independent simultaneous production edits.
evidence.PLN-09: Contract freeze preserves unknown allocation/call intentions, retained capacity, exact physical identity and inspect/stop-only recovery; no automatic replay or native fallback after interruption. Legacy behavior is separately gated.

refutation.candidate: Typed gVisor tools weaken mandatory disposable KVM shell isolation
refutation.counterevidence: Design Scope forbids arbitrary argv/project code/evaluation, permits only fixed helper operations on copied UTF-8 data, and retains I10 for general shell/build.

refutation.candidate: Submitted systemd/OCI resource fields are being treated as observed enforcement
refutation.counterevidence: Scope and AC-764 require all-descendant membership and physical negative controls; freeze explicitly forbids deriving qualification solely from fields and requires absent proof to fail closed.

refutation.candidate: Parallel runtime implementation races shared contract changes
refutation.counterevidence: Architecture explicitly requires core publishes types first; runtime consumes frozen signatures and owns disjoint production areas.
